answer: Require each new identity to post a refundable stake and complete verifiable work whose outputs are publicly checked — like a yarrow cutting that only roots if genuinely planted. Misbehavior burns the stake, so a fake identity costs real money and effort. Honest identities then earn endorsements that ripple outward as peers vouch for them, forcing an attacker to fund many credible histories at once. Like a lotus that opens only after sustained sunlight, reputation accrues slowly and cannot be faked overnight, so a large sybil swarm becomes expensive while entry stays open to one genuine agent.
